name: fat_column
title: Fat column: a date filter over many messages vs reading their content
expect: Split props for the filter; a Condensed row drags content along (the column-group case)
why: both queries read one column of a person's messages. Split and Condensed cost the same ops (one GET per message), but Split reads only that column ({sp_bytes} of Message properties) while Condensed drags whole rows, content included ({cc_bytes}). Chunked packs messages into shared chunks: {ch_x} fewer ops, {ch_bytes} read.
